summary.narrative: Inspection identified 13 verified checks. 1 require immediate remediation to prevent lead leakage, 9 affect conversion consistency or search visibility, and 0 passed technical standards.

revenueImpact.title: LEAD & REVENUE LEAKAGE DETECTED
revenueImpact.description: Content-Security-Policy absent: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.

issues.title: Missing UTF-8 character encoding declaration
issues.evidence: <meta charset="utf-8"> was not found in document <head>.
issues.userImpact: Special characters, currency symbols or accents can display as broken glyphs.
issues.businessImpact: Unprofessional appearance on certain browser locales.
issues.recommendation: Add <meta charset="utf-8"> within the first 1024 bytes of the <head>.

findings.headline: Missing Privacy Policy link
findings.evidence: No link containing "privacy" was detected in footer or navigation.
findings.userImpact: No disclosure on how visitor contact data is processed or stored.
findings.businessImpact: GDPR / CCPA compliance exposure; required for Google Ads approval.
findings.recommendation: Add a dedicated Privacy Policy page linked in the global footer.

findings.headline: Content-Security-Policy absent
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Implement a Content-Security-Policy to protect against cross-site scripting (XSS) and data injection.

findings.headline: Missing HSTS header
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Add Strict-Transport-Security with max-age=31536000 to enforce HTTPS.

findings.headline: Missing X-Frame-Options
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Set X-Frame-Options to DENY or SAMEORIGIN.

findings.headline: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Set X-Content-Type-Options to "nosniff" to prevent MIME-confusion attacks.

findings.headline: Server version exposed
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Disable or mask the Server header to prevent fingerprinting by automated scanners.

findings.headline: Missing or invalid robots.txt
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Add a valid robots.txt file to guide search engine crawlers.

findings.headline: Missing or inaccessible XML Sitemap
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Generate an XML sitemap and reference it in robots.txt to assist discovery.

findings.headline: Missing UTF-8 character encoding declaration
findings.evidence: <meta charset="utf-8"> was not found in document <head>.
findings.userImpact: Special characters, currency symbols or accents can display as broken glyphs.
findings.businessImpact: Unprofessional appearance on certain browser locales.
findings.recommendation: Add <meta charset="utf-8"> within the first 1024 bytes of the <head>.

findings.headline: Missing meta description
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Add an intent-focused meta description between 120–160 characters.

findings.headline: Missing canonical URL
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Specify a self-referencing canonical tag to prevent duplicate content indexing.

findings.headline: Incomplete Open Graph tags
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Add og:title, og:description, and og:image to ensure rich previews when shared on WhatsApp/social media.

findings.headline: Missing structured data (Schema.org)
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD schema found on page
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization or LocalBusiness Schema.org JSON-LD to enhance rich snippets and AI discoverability.
